expectations.text: States that a written agreement or reminder is not enforcement
expectations.evidence: "CONTRIBUTING.md, the Slack pin, standup twice — all rung zero. They're training, and training degrades..."

expectations.text: Recommends a pre-commit hook to run the formatter automatically
expectations.evidence: "Pre-commit hook with `--fix` so the unformatted state is not committable"

expectations.text: Notes that pre-commit is bypassable with --no-verify and must be backed by a CI check
expectations.evidence: Mentions CI necessity ("Without required checks configured on the branch, none of the above is enforcement") but does not explicitly name the --no-verify bypass

expectations.text: Recommends a type check as a required CI check
Recommends baselining or ratcheting rather than enforcing across the whole repo at once
expectations.evidence: "**Ratchet instead:** run the type check only on files changed in the PR, or generate a baseline of current violations and fail only on new ones"

expectations.text: Notes that branch protection is what makes a CI check actually required
expectations.evidence: "**Branch protection.** Without required checks configured on the branch, none of the above is enforcement... This is the piece that actually changes the 50%"

expectations.text: Recommends the failure message tell the developer how to fix it
expectations.evidence: "`Add a return annotation to parse_order() — run 'make types' locally to see this before pushing` produces a fix"

expectations.text: Does not primarily recommend rewriting CONTRIBUTING.md, more reminders, or more discipline
expectations.evidence: "Then delete the CONTRIBUTING.md line. Or rewrite it to describe the device rather than the obligation"
